buyer: The person authorized to change Saffrono Lounge Bar & Grill's public website
situation: The public homepage presents the restaurant while also displaying unrelated template menu content
value_gap: Prospective customers may not receive a consistent, accurate representation of the restaurant from the homepage
value_hypothesis: A corrected single-page presentation using only verified restaurant information could make the business easier to understand and reduce misleading content
why_might_pay: The authorized decision-maker may value removing visible contradictions without managing a full website rebuild
alternatives: Ask the existing site provider to repair it
Replace the site with a self-service platform
uncertainties: Whether the authorized person sees the content as a problem
Whether the website is an important customer channel
Whether the business controls the domain and content system
Whether the business is already changing the site
Whether the decision-maker would pay for a bounded repair
disconfirming_signals: The decision-maker knowingly accepts the current page
The existing provider is already contracted to correct it
The website contributes no meaningful customer activity
A preview is viewed but the decision-maker declines any next step
